_help: Quiz for How Not to Lose Money. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: How much should a beginner put into crypto at first?
options: A small amount they can afford to lose
questions.answer: A small amount they can afford to lose
questions.explain: Starting small lets you learn without real damage.

questions.question: Why do most beginners lose money on perps?
options: Leverage, liquidations and fees work against them
questions.answer: Leverage, liquidations and fees work against them
questions.explain: Small moves can wipe out leveraged positions, and pros sit on the other side.

questions.question: What usually happens to most new memecoins?
options: They lose almost all their value
They are backed by a company
questions.answer: They lose almost all their value
questions.explain: Insiders and bots buy early and sell to the crowd. Most memecoins go to zero.

questions.question: Which is the most reliable source?
options: A project's official docs and onchain data
An anonymous account posting gem calls
questions.answer: A project's official docs and onchain data
questions.explain: Check what actually happened onchain and what the project itself says.

questions.question: An influencer says a token is 'guaranteed to 100x' and you must buy now. What is the best response?
options: Treat it as a red flag and do not rush
Buy before it is too late
questions.answer: Treat it as a red flag and do not rush
questions.explain: Nobody can guarantee returns, and many promoters are paid to post.

questions.question: Someone from 'support' messages you first with a link to fix your wallet. What do you do?
options: Ignore it and use only the official app for help
questions.answer: Ignore it and use only the official app for help
questions.explain: Real support never DMs first and never asks for your seed phrase.

questions.question: A post shows a famous person saying 'send 1 coin and get 2 back'. What is it?
questions.explain: Nobody doubles your crypto. Whatever you send is gone.
